scope: Linux local native acceptance only. No Windows run, package upload, release or sandbox weakening.

successfulSegments.scope: 24 formatting/table edit, isolated undo/redo and full-byte CRLF/Unicode cases; normal PNG picker and trusted native clipboard image import/reopen. Later GTK Save As failed; whole run is not green.
Untitled picker first Save As, resource-aware Save As/reopen, and untitled clipboard first Save As passed. Later clipboard migration chooser timed out.
Clipboard resource migration/reopen and actual owned SIGKILL recovery-copy preview passed with complete Markdown/PNG byte comparisons and original preservation.
True GTK first-save cancellation left unnamed document/version/text/dirty state unchanged and created no Markdown/managed assets; fresh PNG grant retry, exact bytes and isolated undo/redo passed.

Single Home crosses native 760-CSS-pixel breakpoint without losing SELECT focus; all 64 ordinary/windowed × source/live × light/dark × 100/125/150/200 × wide/narrow panel-focus cases pass. Not 64 complete editing-operation suites.

preservedFailures.finding: GTK fatally aborted loading Adwaita image-missing.svg. The following xdotool BadWindow was a consequence. Standalone SVG probes passed inside/outside proot; explicit private loader cache did not eliminate recurrence. No permanent missing-loader or exclusive root-cause claim.

Real GTK Open dialog remained visible with requested path; timeout preserved. Harness adds bounded retries only for the observed real Open dialog and known folder-error acknowledgement; no IPC injection.

Fixed 300ms modal-focus geometry assertion failed before raw screenshot capture. Independent case and exact transition later passed; final bounded stable-sample logs show asynchronous reveal settling, including initial clipped samples. No speculative fractional-rounding product patch.

Single native Home from zoom1.5/innerWidth733 to zoom1/1100 reproducibly moved SELECT focus to TEXTAREA. Main responsive sidebar handler was fixed; candidate03 identical native operation preserves SELECT throughout. Before/after records are separately retained.

Unicode fixture input via WebKitDriver key actions produced duplicated emoji before cancellation began. Cause was not independently isolated to product versus transport. Rerun establishes exact Unicode baseline using a real GTK text clipboard paste; it does not rewrite application state.

environmentChanges.privatePixbufCache: Existing host modules only; no libraries installed; explicit GDK_PIXBUF_MODULE_FILE/MODULEDIR on dedicated processes. Cache alone did not prevent GTK recurrence.
environmentChanges.prootCompatibility: PROOT_NO_SECCOMP=1 on dedicated test processes from cancel01/matrix06 onward disables proot syscall acceleration. Actual proot binary documents this variable. WebKit sandbox was not disabled.
environmentChanges.profile: matrix05 onward reuse the externally installed matrix03 profile, verifying archive sourcePath and active UI. These runs are not fresh-installation evidence.

limits: Native raster fixture is PNG; JPEG/WebP decoding/security are unit-covered, not claimed as native picker coverage.
Image import works in source/live; image previews are live-mode only.
Evidence combines explicitly identified segments and candidates; no claim that an initial end-to-end process completed all stages.
Final focus geometry uses a bounded two-second settling gate and two identical samples with full horizontal/vertical four-CSS-pixel margin; observed settling samples are not a performance benchmark.
